unitVerificationRequired: Use exact primary methods definition; do not infer whether ratio, log-ratio or rate from numerical magnitudes.
sourceDefinition: Cell line growth rates were represented as the ratio between the mean of the untreated negative controls measured at day one (time of drug treatment) and the mean of the dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) treated negative controls at day four (72 h post drug treatment).
sourceScale: Published growth column used as released; mapping of exported numerical scale to the primary control ratio is unverified; no extra transformation. Pinned AssembleSamplesheet.py copies the growth column from an unavailable deprecated workbook without transforming it.
